rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for more than one person, thing, part, instance, or function.

example.traditional: 呢個職位要處理多個項目。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zik1 wai2 jiu3 cyu2 lei5 do1 go3 hong6 muk6

rows.note: Use this for several simultaneous identities, layers, components, or functions, especially in compounds such as 多重國籍.

example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 do1 cung4 gwok3 zik6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something happens again or appears repeatedly rather than simply existing in several instances.

example.english: You don't need to say it multiple times—I heard you.
example.traditional: 你唔使重複講，我聽到喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 cung4 fuk1 gong2 ngo5 teng1 dou2 laa3
